test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 14 Mar 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'VIEWER' is written as ‘XGCYCT’ and ‘DOER’ is written as ‘FMCT’. How will 'FLAGSHIP' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73e690c12a66adaf209adf0b1ff008bb704c48783bd537b818e9d442fb16b230.png] 

**Logic: **

 
• **In consonant addition of +2**
 
• **In vowel subtraction of -2**

'VIEWER' is written as ‘XGCYCT’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/372c6bfa395b7c5c6c6bc445d1bb3d86fa49fed72d0ace6eacc13d240284acb4.png] 

And,

‘DOER’ is written as ‘FMCT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7662cf94937db04400ff4165250a95d879c44938c8aca223cff557aa2b866468.png] 

Similarly,

'FLAGSHIP is written as "?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83f1a65e2ab281d3c18bf131e5dbb9431912270f5b984fed4e7cb2c151eda898.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**HNYIUJGR"**
